home_title: GhulSuite: passwords, 2FA, documents and calendar, encrypted and offline
home_description: GhulSuite is a free offline app for Android and Windows: passwords, 2FA codes, documents and calendar, encrypted with a master password and a security key. No server, no account: the suite is one file you take with you.
hero_pill: Free software for Android and Windows
hero_lead_2: . Encrypted on your device and in one file you take with you. No server, no account, no cloud provider, no tracking.
areas_sub: Each area is made of its own encrypted vaults. Switch on what you need and unlock everything at once. Together they are one file you take to every device.
pass_text: Logins, notes, cards, Wi-Fi and custom fields. Password generator, security check, history and attachments.
auth_text: TOTP, HOTP and Steam codes. Import from Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS and Proton Authenticator by QR code or file.
docs_text: ID, contracts, taxes: encrypted in up to 3 vaults of up to 1 GB each, every file with its own key. Folders, trash, viewing in the app. On Android you scan paper straight in as a PDF.
cal_text: Events, series, reminders and holidays, ICS import and export, time zones converted correctly. With links to entries.
flow_title: What you carry is just random data.
flow_sub: Encryption happens on your device, with a key made from your master password and your security key. What is stored, on the device or in the suite file on your USB stick, is unreadable for anyone else.
flow_1_text: Where the plain text is made and lives.
flow_2_text: Master password and security key or key file.
file_sub: No server, no merging: your suite is one encrypted file (.ghlzip), with all documents up to 3.75 GiB. You save it, for example on a USB stick, and open it on your next device. The state saved last is always the current one.
file_1: Checked before it replaces anything: opening checks every part of the file. If it is older than your state or was edited on from another state, the app asks first.
file_2: Nothing gets lost unnoticed: a banner shows unsaved changes. If the file was saved elsewhere in the meantime, the app asks before overwriting it.
file_3: Everything travels along: passwords, 2FA, all GhulDocs vaults with all documents, and calendar. Saving and opening show progress; with the full 3 GB of documents it takes, by our estimate, seconds on a PC and up to about four and a half minutes on a slow stick.
file_4: Delete old copies: after a change of protection the app no longer opens a suite file with the older protection. A copy elsewhere opens only for someone with the old password and the old second factor. Replace your key or key file and that copy is useless too.
file_5: Single vaults: open a vault file on its own or add it to your suite as a vault of its own. Exporting is for you (your protection); “Share as separate vault” gives a whole vault or selected entries to someone else as a new vault with a password, key file or security key and recovery code of its own, GhulDocs with its documents as a GhulDocs package (.ghldocs).
file_img: Unlock screen with the option to open another suite or vault
scan_sub: On Android you photograph letters and contracts with the camera inside the app and save them as a PDF in GhulDocs. No scanner app, no cloud.
scan_1: Several pages in a row, all in one PDF, named after the date.
scan_2: Crop with your finger: the app suggests the corners of the sheet and straightens a sheet photographed at an angle.
scan_3: "Document" filter: grayscale and more contrast for text, and turning.
scan_4: Nothing on disk: photos and pages stay in memory until the PDF is encrypted in GhulDocs.
scan_img: Cropping a sheet: four corners to move
sec_title: Built like a vault. Open like a book.
sec_sub: Proven cryptography, a core in Rust and an openly documented file format. Anyone can check what happens.
sec_1_text: Argon2id for the master password, FIDO2 hmac-secret for the security key. Without both, nobody gets to your data.
sec_2_text: XChaCha20-Poly1305 and a seal for every vault, new inner keys with every change of protection, recovery with an emergency sheet.
sec_3_text: One shared, memory-safe code base for Android and Windows, checked with test vectors from Wycheproof and the RFCs.
sec_4_text: Shake, quick tile or auto lock. Screenshots and apps drawing over GhulSuite are blocked.
sec_5_text: No telemetry, no ads, no account, no server. The only things that go online are the update check and, if you switch it on, the leak check.
sec_6_text: Updates from inside the app. Only what carries the developer's signature and matches its checksum gets installed.
stat_3: time zones checked against the IANA database
sec_honest: To be honest: GhulSuite is a solo project and has not been audited independently yet. What is tested, what was found and what is open is all in the test log and the security report (in German).
off_sub: GhulSuite needs no network and no account. The app makes only two connections, and you can switch off both.
off_1: At most once a day the app asks GitHub for a new version. It installs only after you agree and only what carries the developers' signature. Switch it off under Options, About, Updates.
off_2: Only if you switch it on in the security check of GhulPass: for each password the first 5 characters of its SHA-1 value go to Pwned Passwords (Have I Been Pwned), never the password itself.
off_3: The app only shows it, without vault contents. Whether you copy it, save it or send it to the developer with your mail app is up to you. GhulSuite sends nothing by itself.
off_need: You decide where your data is: on the device and in the suite file, wherever you save it. If it is in a folder another program uploads to a cloud, it is encrypted and sealed there.
gallery_sub: On the phone and on Windows, light and dark, with one clear layout in all four areas.
dl_sub: For Android 10 and newer and for Windows. Afterwards, updates come straight from the app.
dl_zip_sub: For a USB stick, no installation
dl_stable_text: Released and meant for everyday use.
dl_pre_text: Newer, but less tested. For everyone who wants to try new things first.
dl_none_stable: The first stable version is coming soon. Until then, you can try the pre-release.
dl_note: Every version comes with signed checksums (SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.sig). The app installs an update only if signature, size and checksum match. The Windows installer is not signed by Microsoft yet: SmartScreen asks on first start.
oss_sub: GhulSuite is free software under the AGPL-3.0. Read along, check, report bugs or join in.
footer_claim: Passwords, 2FA, documents and calendar. Encrypted on your device and in your file.
notice_text: No cookies, no tracking. This site only remembers in your browser that you have seen this notice and which language you chose.
wip_text: GhulSuite is still under development and not suitable for production use. Whole parts of the app and the file format may change at any time, without migrating older data.
